grades.reason: Describes LoongArch floating-point division (FDIV.S/D), not integer division, and says nothing about division by zero.
Covers the RISC-V FCVTMOD.W.D float-to-integer conversion, which has nothing to do with integer division by zero.

grades.quote: The `DIV.W` and `DIV.WU` instruction performs the operation that divide the `[31:0]` bit data in the general register `rj` by the `[31:0]` bit data in the general register `rk` , and the resulting quotient is sign extension and written into the general register `rd` .
grades.reason: Defines the LoongArch integer DIV/MOD instructions and their normal results. It never says what happens when the divisor is zero (result or exception), so it gives only limited background.
This is only the introduction to the RISC-V M extension chapter. It gives no division-by-zero result or exception behavior.
